details: Fetched the published fix and reviewed the exact delta. Claim verified: git diff --stat 4449fcb 0b398ff shows only src/artifact-store.ts (7 lines: one bind + a five-line comment) and tests/artifacts.test.ts (206 lines); git diff over src/docs/.gitignore/package.json/bun.lock confirms artifact-store.ts is the only production file touched. Consistency re-audit at 0b398ff: every ifnull(run_id,'') comparison now binds the same normalization - preserved() :912 source.run_id ?? '', insert() :828, restoreSuperseded() :978, find() :1111 - matching the index predicate at :744, so NULL and '' remain one source as before and no new asymmetry is introduced. Behaviour, not just text: probe 10 was rewritten to assert the fixed behaviour and is red on 4449fcb (SQLiteError UNIQUE constraint failed on index artifacts_source) and green on 0b398ff - a no-run-id recapture publishes, supersedes the previous row, keeps both byte sets readable under their own ids, restores the previous copy as current when a later recapture fails, leaves PRAGMA integrity_check ok and leaves no preserving row. The four new owner tests are real, not mocks: real localHarness and real helper transport, deterministic interleaving by gating the first staged stream, and one labelled storage.put fault for the failure case. Owner suite at 0b398ff (bun 1.4.2, frozen lockfile): 122 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail, 890 expect() calls, up from 118 with the four new regressions; my probes 12 pass / 0 fail / 79 expect(); tsc --noEmit exit 0; biome clean 49 files; git status clean after the run. F1 re-proven against this head's shipped helper (fdleak2.py retargeted at 0b398ff): 402 descriptors leaked per 400-directory metadata walk and OSError EMFILE at RLIMIT_NOFILE=200; the walk raises EMFILE, the blanket 'except HelperError' in _walk_metadata turns it into 'Git metadata directory is not inside the permitted root', and op_capture records a GitRefusal as skipped without setting stats['incomplete'], so complete stays true and no incomplete label reaches artifact-transport.ts:446. Two-line fix asked for: close the descriptor passed to os.scandir, and let EMFILE/ENOMEM/EACCES/EINTR/EBADF from the walk reach stats['incomplete'] instead of being reported as a security verdict. Keeping it blocking because a large repository is then silently stored as a complete Git report containing no Git information, which contradicts the invariant the code states itself. Everything else stands from the 4449fcb pass: F2 documentation note (plain .git with objects and refs inside the workspace, so linked worktrees/submodules/shared object-store symlinks yield no Git report), F5 stated assumption about /opt/swarmforge ownership, F3/F4 optional. The life/cache head ab56 was not reviewed - it is the life owner's assignment. No production code modified.

followup_reason: One item left: F1 in src/providers/artifact-helper.py, untouched by 0b398ff and re-proven against this head. Close the descriptor passed to os.scandir in _walk_metadata, and stop reporting an environment failure (EMFILE/ENOMEM/EACCES/EINTR/EBADF) as 'not inside the permitted root' with complete:true - it must reach stats['incomplete'] so a repository that cannot be verified is stored as an incomplete Git report instead of a complete one containing nothing. Separately, the docs owner should note that Git diagnostics need a plain .git directory with objects and refs inside the workspace (linked worktrees, submodules and shared object-store symlinks produce no Git report). Re-review after F1 is scoped to _walk_metadata and the incomplete labelling.
